scope: Held-out 8B total profiling-plus-inference comparison, conditional on separately audited correctness mitigation.
primary_endpoint: Actual total seconds through16 passes (1536 requests), reported separately by batch and order. Compare transferred default and pair with full sweep; do not require a positive result.

methods.zero_transfer: Use width3 at batch64 and maximum legal width7 at batch8, translating prior4B batch-dependent rule. No current-run profiling.
methods.native_pair: Profile widths3 and7; choose lowest timed profile seconds.
methods.full_native: Profile all legal widths1..7; choose lowest timed profile seconds.

accounting: Actual same-host monotonic wall clock from pipeline start through inference milestones. Includes subprocess imports, engine startup, all profiling warmups/timing, stage teardown, selection and deployment startup. Deployment first pass is counted useful inference, with no excluded deployment warmup. Queue time and common freshAR correctness-reference cost excluded; reference cost reported separately. Per-stage files and correctness-check overhead remain included.
cache_condition: All methods use identical per-batch/width cache_v114 caches, populated during the correctness gate. Fresh engine processes each stage; precision mitigation identical across controls. Cached-start, not cold-start. Gate costs reported separately.
selection_safety: Only profile outcomes enter selection; save choices before heldout deployment. No retuning after heldout outcomes.
freshness: Use96 validation prompts disjoint from192 profiling prompts and untouched by v110. Existing8B profiling results already inspected; rules frozen before held-out8B inference, not a blind new-model discovery claim.
limitations: 96unique heldout prompts repeated16times, not1536 independent samples.
Prior8B profiling already inspected; prospective heldout deployment, not blind transfer.
{3,maximum} is an explicit reinterpretation of4B {3,8}, as8B maxwidth is7.
One8B model/H200, two timing orders; no population significance claim.
FP32-head configuration mitigation; original intermittent BF16 mismatch not root-caused. Results do not directly compare to earlier BF16-head timings.
correctness: v114 exact equality gate on200 regression prompts, both batches, allwidths1..7, two engine loads, two warmup/two timed passes each. Failure prevents heldout job. Fresh heldout AR and every native stage must also pass. No relaxed comparison or dropped failures.
